add.k: The former colonel who rules Genosha as its Leader
st: In season 1, the Leader enslaves mutants to build a dam for Master Mold, until Cable ambushes him and the flood sweeps them away.

files.notes: Slave Island (ep 7). He calls himself 'your Leader' over the PA and tells Gyrich 'I am called "Leader" now' after Gyrich greets him as 'Colonel'. Group: 'Genosha', the app's existing name for the Genoshan state and army Cable served in. Washed away by the flood with Cable and Hodge; his fate is not shown, so Missing.

add.k: A Morlock boy who can switch off mutant powers
st: In season 1, Leech lures Cyclops into the Morlock tunnels for Callisto, then cancels his powers so he can see without his visor.
In season 3, Leech steals a device from Lady Deathstrike for Callisto, and she forces him to lure Wolverine into the tunnels.
In season 4, Leech falls gravely ill at Christmas, and a transfusion of Wolverine's blood saves his life.
In season 1, Magneto saves Leech from a hostile crew in the sewers, but Leech later dies when a giant Sentinel attacks Genosha.

files.notes: Captive Hearts (5), Out of the Past I (27), Have Yourself a Morlock Little X-Mas (62), Wikipedia numbering; X-Men '97 S1E2 and S1E5 (death per the Marvel Database: killed by the Wild Sentinel on Genosha; his last line is in S1E5). Named in dialogue throughout ('You help Leech, Leech help you'; 'Leech is very sick'; 'Please, don't hurt Leech'). Not stepped: an on-screen-only shot in Sanctuary I (48) (season 4 already has a step). Season 5 step: a silent cameo with the Morlocks in Graduation Day (76), per the Marvel Database. Kept 'The Morlocks' for X-Men '97 too (Callisto's file uses 'Genosha' there; the screen still calls them Morlocks).

st: In season 2, Domo suggests the X-Men as Mojo's new stars after Longshot quits, then watches the whole show collapse.
In season 3, Domo urges Mojo to lead an expedition to Earth himself to bring back the runaway Longshot.

files.notes: Mojovision (24) and Longshot (36, Wikipedia season 3; Marvel Database S5E5). Mojo only ever calls him 'Domo' ('Domo!'), so n is 'Domo'; 'Major Domo' is the wiki's name and is never said. That he is the one suggesting the X-Men and the expedition is read from the subtitles, which have no speaker names for those lines; the flowery titles ('O Bulbous One', 'my lardaceous liege') are his. Group: 'Mojo's network', the app's existing name.

add.k: A Morlock girl, Leech's best friend
st: In season 4, Marianna frets over her sick friend Leech and shares the Morlocks' Christmas with Jubilee.
In season 5, Marianna is among the many mutants gathered on Genosha around Magneto.

files.notes: Have Yourself a Morlock Little X-Mas (62): Jubilee asks 'Do you believe in miracles, Mariana?' and Storm says 'Mariana asked you a question, Jubilee'; spelled Marianna as on the wiki (the subtitles spell it Mariana). Season 5 step is a crowd cameo in Graduation Day (76), per the Marvel Database list of Genoshan mutants and her page.

st: In season 1, Sunder takes the captured Cyclops and Jean down into the Morlock tunnels for Callisto, then brawls with Rogue.
In season 3, Sunder is among the Morlocks held when Lady Deathstrike's Reavers raid their tunnels.
In season 4, Sunder turns up among the mutants of Skull Mesa, then spends Christmas back in the Morlock tunnels.

files.notes: Named in Captive Hearts (5): 'Sunder, take them below', 'Now where's Jean? Sunder.' His fight line 'Come down here and fight me fair' is labelled SUNDER and answered by Rogue. Raft file because his only real part is the attack on the X-Men; after Storm wins the Morlocks he stays with them, so later steps are Allied. Season 3 (Out of the Past, 27-28) and season 4 cameos (Sanctuary 48-49, Secrets, Not Long Buried 52, Morlock Little X-Mas 62) are per the Marvel Database; he has no lines there. Season 5 step: a silent cameo with the Morlocks in Graduation Day (76); his Marvel Database page says he returned to the Morlocks there.

st: In season 1, Martha doubts her husband's choice to register Jubilee as a mutant, then helps Cyclops when Sentinels take the girl.

files.notes: Night of the Sentinels I and II (1-2). Her husband calls her by name ('She's one of them, Martha'; 'The agency isn't a prison, Martha'). In part II, Cyclops tells her Jubilee was likely taken by Sentinels; she passes it on and her husband warns Cyclops that Gyrich is coming (Marvel Database synopsis and transcript). A cameo in The Juggernaut Returns is only the recap, so not stepped. No group: Independent.

add.k: The Sentinel master that rules mutants in 2055
st: In season 4, in 2055, Master Mold sends Fitzroy back to 1959 to kill the young Xavier, then orders Nimrod to destroy Fitzroy as well.

files.notes: One Man's Worth I and II (54-55). Named on screen ('fighting against Mastermold and his Sentinels'; 'Mastermold will become all powerful'). A different machine from the app's fox-anim-master-mold that Xavier destroys in season 1, so it gets its own id; its n is the same 'Master Mold', so any tie by name needs this id. It commands Sentinels, but the screen names no group, so Independent. No ties: it shares no screen time with anyone in the Network list (its scenes are with Fitzroy, Bantam and Nimrod).

add.k: Leader of the Belganian resistance on Polemachus
st: In season 5, Mentor leads the Belganian resistance, freeing Arkon's slaves with Wolverine and Beast and hiding them from Arkon.

files.notes: Storm Front II (70). He introduces himself: 'I am Mentor, leader of the Belganian resistance.' No wiki page exists; facts from the transcript and the Marvel Database episode page. Group name as said on screen; it is new to the app.

add.k: A brawler in Mister Sinister's Nasty Boys
st: In season 2, Hairbag helps the Nasty Boys capture Cyclops and Jean on their honeymoon, then fights the X-Men again in the Savage Land.
In season 4, Hairbag helps the Nasty Boys snatch Jean on her wedding day for Mister Sinister, then retreats with them.

files.notes: Till Death Do Us Part II (15), Reunion I and II (25-26), Beyond Good and Evil I and IV (63, 66), Wikipedia numbering. Named in Till Death Do Us Part II ('hairbag!', 'Nobody makes fun of Hairbag!') and in Beyond Good and Evil I ('Ruckus, Vertigo, Hairbag, move it!'). Reunion and part IV appearances are per the Marvel Database. 'The Nasty Boys' is said on screen.

add.k: The medicine man of Canada's Alpha Flight
st: In season 2, Shaman helps Alpha Flight capture his friend Wolverine, then turns on Department H with his team to free him.
In season 3, Shaman and Alpha Flight help Canada through the chaos when D'Ken uses the M'Kraan Crystal.

files.notes: Repo Man (18): Wolverine calls him by name ('Out of my way, Shaman!', 'Forget it, Shaman') and he speaks ('I am your friend, Wolverine'). Season 3 step is a cameo in Phoenix Saga V: Child of Light (33), per his Marvel Database page. His real name Michael Twoyoungmen is never said.

st: In season 2, the Shadow King possesses MjNari, and once freed he helps Storm and Rogue drive the villain back into the astral plane.
In season 3, MjNari helps his people through the chaos that sweeps Earth when D'Ken uses the M'Kraan Crystal.
In season 4, MjNari watches on television as Magneto announces a mutant haven on Asteroid M.

files.notes: Whatever It Takes (16): named again and again by Storm and Shani; speaks ('The mountain!', 'Come on, you coward!'). Season 3 (Child of Light, 33) and season 4 (Sanctuary I, 48) are cameos per his Marvel Database page. No group: Independent.

add.k: A resin-wielding thug in Solarr's gang
st: In season 4, Toad helps Solarr rule Skull Mesa and keeps Dr. Prescott frozen in his resin, until the townsfolk rise against them.
In season 5, Toad is among the many mutants gathered on Genosha around Magneto.

files.notes: Secrets, Not Long Buried (52): Solarr names him ('Toad!', 'Toad here is quite versatile. This particular resin acts like curare.'); Toad laughs and taunts the powerless Cyclops. Solarr's gang is called the Children of the Shadow by the wikis, but the transcript never says it: Independent. The townsfolk keep the gang to judge in Skull Mesa (In custody). Season 5 step is a crowd cameo in Graduation Day (76), per the Marvel Database list of Genoshan mutants. A different person from the film Toad.

add.k: The babbling self-styled janitor of the Axis of Time
st: In season 4, Bender guides the stranded Bishop through the Axis of Time, showing him glimpses of Apocalypse's plot to unravel history.

files.notes: Beyond Good and Evil I, III and IV (63, 65, 66). He says 'Call me Bender, so few do' and calls himself a 'custodial engineer'. The wikis say he is Immortus in disguise, but the name Immortus is never said or shown on screen, so the file stays 'Bender'. He helps Bishop, so a hero file. No group: Independent.

add.k: A Shi'ar officer aboard Commander Raknar's ship
st: In season 3, Navigator serves aboard Raknar's ship, then shows Cyclops a faked log proving Raknar plans to murder the witness Jandra.

files.notes: Orphan's End (44): named by Raknar ('Navigator, I leave our guest in your care') and labelled NAVIGATOR in the subtitles. Earlier unnamed appearances in Phoenix Saga IV and V (32-33) fall in the same season. The line 'I went to your father for help' is read as hers from context (subtitles name no speaker); the Marvel Database says she turned on Raknar and sided with Corsair. Group: 'Shi'ar Empire', the app's existing name.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cable once fought in the Leader's army, until he learned the Leader was no champion of democracy and took to the hills. Cable raids the Sentinel factory and stops the fleeing Leader just before the flood sweeps them both away.
stages.whoA: His former soldier, now the rebel hunting him
stages.whoB: The Genoshan ruler he served, then rose against

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gyrich, an old associate who still calls him Colonel, comes to Genosha to see Master Mold. He offers to have Cable eliminated in exchange for large numbers of the Leader's mutant control collars.
stages.whoA: An old associate bargaining for his collars
stages.whoB: Genosha's Leader, an old colonel he deals with

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Trask unveils Master Mold to the Leader and Gyrich in a factory on Genosha. The dam the Leader's mutant slaves are building is meant to power it.
stages.whoA: The scientist building Sentinels on his island
stages.whoB: Genosha's ruler, host to his Sentinel factory

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gambit is one of the mutants the Leader enslaves to build his dam. Brought before the Leader and Gyrich, Gambit promises to lead them to the X-Men, then escapes and frees the slaves.
stages.whoA: A mutant slave who fakes cooperation, then escapes
stages.whoB: The ruler who enslaves him on Genosha

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Callisto sends Leech to lure Cyclops into the Morlock tunnels, and later has him steal a device from Lady Deathstrike's lab. When Leech falls gravely ill at Christmas, Callisto demands that Storm help save him.
stages.whoA: The Morlock leader he serves
stages.whoB: A Morlock boy who runs her errands

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops tries to help Leech escape an angry mob, not knowing Callisto sent the boy to lure him underground. As thanks, Leech cancels Cyclops' powers so he can see without his visor.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he lured underground for Callisto
stages.whoB: The Morlock boy who cancelled his powers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Lady Deathstrike forces Leech to lure Wolverine into the Morlock tunnels with a message from Yuriko. At Christmas, Wolverine gives his blood in a transfusion that saves Leech's life.
stages.whoA: The X-Man whose blood saved his life
stages.whoB: The Morlock boy he saved with his blood

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Leech steals a device from Lady Deathstrike's lab for Callisto, and she catches him. She makes him carry a message that lures Wolverine into her trap.
stages.whoA: The cyborg who caught him and used him as bait
stages.whoB: The Morlock thief she uses as bait

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Marianna stays close while her best friend Leech lies gravely ill at Christmas. Wolverine's blood brings him back, and Jubilee tells her he is okay.
stages.whoA: His best friend among the Morlock children
stages.whoB: Her best friend, who falls gravely ill

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Magneto rescues Leech from a hostile crew in the sewers and promises he will never be afraid again. On Genosha, Leech holds on to that promise as the Sentinels attack.
stages.whoA: The mutant who saved him in the sewers
stages.whoB: A Morlock boy he saved and promised to protect

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Domo serves Mojo with endless flowery titles, putting up with his rants and suggesting the X-Men as his new stars. Later he backs the plan for Mojo to lead an expedition to Earth after Longshot.
stages.whoA: The ranting showman he serves
stages.whoB: His deadpan right-hand man

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Marianna asks Jubilee whether Leech will be okay, and Jubilee asks her if she believes in miracles. She invites Jubilee to share the Morlocks' Christmas, and Jubilee tells her when Leech pulls through.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who stays with her through Christmas
stages.whoB: A Morlock girl she comforts at Christmas

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sunder serves Callisto, carrying the captured Cyclops and Jean into the tunnels on her orders and fighting the X-Men until Storm beats her. He stays with her Morlocks afterward.
stages.whoA: The Morlock leader he serves
stages.whoB: Her Morlock strongman

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When the X-Men storm the Morlock tunnels, Sunder dares Rogue to come down and fight him fair. Rogue takes him on and gets the better of him.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who beats him in a fair fight
stages.whoB: A Morlock strongman she takes down

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Callisto's orders, Sunder takes the unconscious Cyclops and Jean below into the Morlock tunnels. Cyclops is freed when Storm wins her duel with Callisto.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he dragged into the tunnels
stages.whoB: The Morlock who carried him below

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Martha is Jubilee's foster mother, uneasy when her husband registers the girl with the Mutant Control Agency. After the X-Men rescue her, Jubilee says goodbye to her foster parents and moves into Xavier's school.
stages.whoA: Her foster daughter, a young mutant
stages.whoB: Her foster mother

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops visits Martha's home looking for Jubilee and tells her the girl was likely taken by Sentinels. She passes this on, and her husband warns Cyclops that Gyrich is on his way.
stages.whoA: The X-Man searching for her foster daughter
stages.whoB: Jubilee's foster mother

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mentor pulls Wolverine away from Arkon's robot guards and asks for his help freeing the Belganian slaves. Wolverine joins the rescue and the resistance hides the X-Men in its caverns.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who helps him free his people
stages.whoB: Leader of the Belganian resistance

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Beast fights beside Mentor's resistance to free Arkon's slaves and is wounded in the escape. In the caverns, Mentor shows him and the X-Men the tower behind Arkon's police state.
stages.whoA: The X-Man wounded helping free his people
stages.whoB: Leader of the Belganian resistance

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hairbag serves in Mister Sinister's Nasty Boys, helping capture Cyclops and Jean and fighting the X-Men in the Savage Land. He later helps snatch Jean from her wedding for Sinister.
stages.whoA: The master of his Nasty Boys
stages.whoB: One of his Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hairbag helps the Nasty Boys collar Cyclops and Jean on their honeymoon island for Sinister. The gang strikes again at their wedding and carries Jean off.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he helps capture
stages.whoB: A brawler in Sinister's Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hairbag helps the Nasty Boys capture Jean and Cyclops on their honeymoon for Sinister. When they marry, the Nasty Boys crash the wedding and take Jean.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he helps snatch for Sinister
stages.whoB: A brawler in Sinister's Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Shaman calls Wolverine his friend even as Alpha Flight hunts him down for Department H. Once the team learns what Department H wants, Shaman helps set Wolverine free.
stages.whoA: His old friend who left Alpha Flight
stages.whoB: The Alpha Flight mystic who calls him friend

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Storm breathed life into MjNari as a newborn and became his godmother. When the Shadow King possesses him, Storm offers her own body to free him, and together they drive the villain back into the astral plane.
stages.whoA: His godmother, who breathed life into him
stages.whoB: Her godson in Africa

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Shadow King possesses MjNari and lays waste to the villages. Freed, MjNari lures him back into the tear in the astral plane before it seals.
stages.whoA: The psychic who possessed him
stages.whoB: A boy he possesses in Africa

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: MjNari catches Rogue when the possessed Storm knocks her out of the sky. Rogue and Storm then save him as the tear in the astral plane seals.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he catches as she falls
stages.whoB: Storm's godson, who catches her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Toad helps Solarr hold Skull Mesa and taunts the powerless Cyclops, whose friend Dr. Prescott he keeps frozen in resin. Cyclops rallies the townsfolk, who turn on Solarr's gang.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who breaks Solarr's hold on the town
stages.whoB: A resin-wielding thug in Solarr's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bender finds Bishop lost in the Axis of Time and leads him around with riddles and jokes, showing him glimpses of the X-Men and Cable. His hints help Bishop free the captive psychics and stop Apocalypse.
stages.whoA: The babbling janitor who guides him through time
stages.whoB: The lost time traveler he guides

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raknar leaves the captive Cyclops in Navigator's care, and she shows him a faked ship's log proving Raknar means to kill the witness Jandra. The truth turns Cyclops against Raknar.
stages.whoA: The X-Man she shows the truth about Raknar
stages.whoB: Raknar's navigator, who exposes his plot

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Navigator turned to Corsair for help, trusting him to save the witness Jandra from Raknar. Her proof helps Corsair's son Cyclops see that his father told the truth.
stages.whoA: The Starjammer she asked to save Jandra
stages.whoB: A Shi'ar officer who asked him to save Jandra

dropped.why: The screen never names the speaking Phalanx ruler. In The Phalanx Covenant the voice that talks to Hodge refers to 'the nexus' in the third person ('all Phalanx will rejoin the nexus'), and Warlock speaks of freeing the home world 'from the nexus'; the being in the Spire is only called 'the Phalanx nucleus' (subtitle label NUCLEUS). 'The nexus' is the home world collective, not this character's name, and the app's 'The Phalanx' file already covers the collective.
